title: skills(ui): the page skill learns the print page — `print`, the printable block subset and its lint (#22271)
body:
Fixes #22271

Clause-②: no

The Studio author's page skill (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`) learns the print page that card ① of the ruling of record on #8346 (comment 6051470224, letter B′, maintainer 「8346 B′」) landed as #22158 through PR #22193: a printable document is a page that declares `print`; the eight `print` keys and what each means on paper; the three page types that may carry it; the printable block subset taught by reason, not as a copied list; the `print-page-block-unprintable` refusal; and the two list facts (list export has no `'pdf'`; a list prints through the view's `allowPrinting`). #8346, #22158, #22193 and #22184 are references — none of them is addressed here.

Every sentence is true of `origin/main` at `c8bb3c8d9c` (this branch's base): the declaration is parsed and refused by `@objectstack/spec` (`PagePrintSchema`, `checkPagePrintComposition`) and by `@objectstack/lint` (`validatePrintPageBlocks`, rule `print-page-block-unprintable`, on `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and the page save door). What renders it is the console's print rendering — card ② of the same ruling, not on this tree — so the skill says in one clause that the rendering follows and that `os validate` warns the author today (the liveness row `print` is `planned` with `authorWarn`, `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`). No rendering is invented.

## What changes (three markdown files, nothing else)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` — a new `### Print pages` section under Pages: what a print page is and the refused page kinds/types (`list` → `interfaceConfig.allowPrinting`, `utility`, `slotted` / `html` / `react`, a `full` page with no regions); the keys `paperSize`, `orientation`, `margins` (millimetres), `repeatHeader` / `repeatFooter` (the page's own `header` / `footer` regions; refused without that region), `pageNumbers`, `repeatTableHeaders` (on by default), `avoidBreakInside`; the printable subset stated as the property every member has (draws all it declares, in full, the same at any width) with the 13 members grouped by that property; the four refusal reasons with the blocks an author reaches for first (`record:related_list` / `object-grid` → `record:line_items`; `page:header`, sidebars, boards; `record:path`, tabs, buttons, inputs, forms → `record:details`; `flex` / `object-chart` / plugin widgets are outside the vocabulary); the rendering status in one clause; the two list facts; and one `os:check` invoice example (`type: 'record'`, `print` with margins / running header and footer / page numbers, `element:text` letterhead, `record:details`, `record:line_items`, a footer region).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` — one word in the Detailed Rules routing row for pages.md ("print pages"), so an author routing from the entry file finds the section.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` — one sentence beside the `OpenInvoicePdfAction` example: a printable document is a page that declares `print` (link to the section), validated today, rendered once the console's print rendering ships. The example itself is untouched (with only card ① landed, a per-project endpoint is still the only working route to a PDF today). Paid by deleting the three "Best practices" bullets the file already states elsewhere: `confirmText` for destructive actions (line 20), `visible` to hide an action (line 18), `input.selectedIds` for bulk actions (the `list_toolbar` row and the `AddToCampaignAction` example); the `refreshAfter` bullet, which had no other home, stays.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/*.json` — untouched: no eval quotes a changed line. Eval 4's `expected_output` names the record-page lessons (`page:header` with `properties.actions`, `record:path` with `statusField` / `stages`) that now live in the component catalogue rows.

## Ratchet route and readings (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, convention ceil(utf8 bytes / 4))

**Why the section lives inside `pages.md` and not in a new file.** The ratchet admits no new file on an author's own: a discovered authored file with no ceiling is RED, and its remedy carries the maintainer-only marker — "adding a CEILINGS row prices new text into the bundle that ships to every customer project, which is the maintainer ruling this ratchet implements — not a step an author takes while landing the file." So the section is paid inside `pages.md` by deletion, with no re-wrap counted and no ceiling moved.

Measured on `c8bb3c8d9c` (before) and on this PR's head (after); `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` at the head: `pages.md is 5691 tokens (ceiling 5692; headroom 1)`, `SKILL.md … 3847 (ceiling 3856; headroom 9)`, `actions.md … 2101 (ceiling 2108; headroom 7)`, exit 0.

## Controls (against the built `@objectstack/spec` dist at the head, `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` VERDICT command-exit 0)

- Positive: the invoice example exactly as `pages.md` carries it → `PageSchema.safeParse` success = true, `print` parsed as `{"paperSize":"A4","margins":{"top":15,"right":12,"bottom":15,"left":12},"repeatHeader":true,"repeatFooter":true,"pageNumbers":true}`; `validatePrintPageBlocks({ pages: [example] })` → `[]`.
- Refused by the lint rule (the same page holding unprintable blocks): rule `print-page-block-unprintable`, severity `error`, each with its reason — "`page:header` cannot be placed in a print page … it lays its action bar out to the screen width"; "`record:related_list` … draws only the first `limit` related records (5 unless set) … a window of the rows"; "`flex` … is not in the printable block subset, and nothing answers for how it prints"; "`record:path` … is an interactive stage control; the current stage is a field value, which `record:details` prints".
- Refused at the parse: `print` on a `type: 'list'` page ("… set `interfaceConfig.allowPrinting: true`; to print a document, declare `print` on a page of `type: 'record'`, `'home'` or `'app'` with its blocks in `regions`"); `repeatHeader: true` with no `header` region ("Add a `{ name: 'header', components: [...] }` region holding the letterhead blocks, or delete `repeatHeader`"); `paperSize: 'A3'` ("expected one of A4 | A5 | Letter | Legal"); `print` on a `utility` page; `print` on a `kind: 'react'` page.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` at the head: "262 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them", exit 0 (the new invoice block is one of the 228 skills + docs blocks).

Not run locally, CI's own: the type-check lanes and `pnpm lint` (no TypeScript or source file moves). No changeset: the diff publishes nothing from a released package (`skills/**` is not in any package's `files`), so `skip-changeset` is the declaration.

## Acceptance notes (not filed; carrier named)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:108` declares a `doc` navigation-item type (`{ type: 'doc', book }` / `{ type: 'doc', doc }`) and `SKILL.md`'s nav table lists it, but `pages.md` → Routing model still says "There is no dedicated `doc` nav-item type yet, so use a `url` item", and eval 4's `expected_output` expects a `type: 'url'` nav item. A stale line in the published skill; a different defect class from this card, so not touched here. Carrier: the `domain:skills` seat, reported in this card's os-dev-report for filing.
- The print-page example omits `template` (spec default `'default'`); whether a print page constrains `template` is card ②'s call (PR #22193's own note). The skill does not speak about it.
- Rendering: the skill's one clause ("the console's print rendering that applies it follows") is the only forward-looking sentence; the day card ② lands at a `.objectui-sha` pin, that clause and the `os validate` warning sentence are the two lines to revise.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 给 Studio 作者技能的页面规则(`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`)新增一节「Print pages」:可打印文档(发票、送货单、信函、报表)就是声明了 `print` 的普通页面,没有模板类型;八个 `print` 键各自对应纸面上的什么;只有带 `regions` 的 `record` / `home` / `app` 页面可以声明;打印页里只允许「整页画全、任意宽度布局不变」的块,其余块被 `print-page-block-unprintable` 拒绝并给出原因(只画一窗行、按屏幕布局、无可打印内容、词汇表之外);列表导出没有 `'pdf'`,列表靠视图的 `allowPrinting`。附一个会被 `check:skill-examples` 类型检查的发票页示例。SKILL.md 路由行加「print pages」一词;actions.md 的「打开发票 PDF」示例旁加一句指向打印页。

**为什么改** — #8346 裁决 B′ 原话:「the Studio author's skill learns the print page when ① lands」;① 已随 PR #22193 落地。spec 与 lint 会响亮拒绝写错的打印页,但没学过这个声明的 AI 作者根本不会去写它,只会继续给每个项目手搓一个 PDF 接口;技能文本是 `npx skills add` 直接发到每个客户项目的那份。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 发布技能包有 token 棘轮:`pages.md` 只剩 13 token 余量,新节靠删除同文件里重复的内容付账(记录详情页示例整块删除、其教学点并入组件目录表格;另 11 处重复句,逐条列在上文表格里,唯一一条非重复的是「文档门户是后续事项」这句路线图备注),净 +12 token,落在 5691/5692;SKILL.md +3、actions.md −3,三个上限都没动。风险一:AI 作者看到打印页示例,把 `print` 加到普通页面 —— 文本已写明只有文档才声明,spec 也会拒绝不合格的页面;风险二:今天没有渲染器读 `print`(裁决的卡 ② objectui 未落地),技能用一句话如实说明「已校验、渲染随后」,`os validate` 也会提示作者。回滚:整个 PR 只动三个 markdown 文件,revert 即可,无代码、无 changeset。

**席位意见** —

**你要做的** — 核对「Print pages」一节的措辞与上文的删除清单;认可则 APPROVE 这个 draft PR,由你或授权审批落地(`skills/**` 为 Tier H)。
